'''2001 tournament won by Rebekah''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament on 2001. Rebekah won it. It is known from Ryan McLain's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2273">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-09-rebekah-s-friend-s-memoriald2273/ rebekah-s-friend-s-memorial], DeckTech (Ryan "_Rx_" McLain, 9 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-09-rebekah-s-friend-s-memoriald2273/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2001
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 17
* '''Winner:''' Rebekah
